description: Defines Pydantic data models for the NoteMaster API, including note and tag schemas for requests and responses.

classes.name: NoteBase
classes.description: Base model containing common fields for notes, such as title, content, tags, pinned, and starred status.

classes.name: NoteCreate
classes.description: Model used for creating new notes, extending NoteBase.

classes.name: NoteUpdate
classes.description: Model used for updating existing notes; all fields are optional.

classes.name: NoteOut
classes.description: Model representing the full note data when returned from the API, including metadata like id, timestamps.

classes.name: NoteListOut
classes.description: Model encapsulating a list of notes with total count.

classes.name: TagCreate
classes.description: Model for creating new tags with a name.

classes.name: TagUpdate
classes.description: Model for updating existing tags, with optional name.

classes.name: TagOut
classes.description: Model representing a tag with id, name, and creation timestamp.

classes.name: TagListOut
classes.description: Model encapsulating a list of tags with total count.
